subject: Physics
title: Moving Charges and Magnetism
summary: Chalta charge (current) apne aas-paas magnetic field B banata hai (Oersted). Ek current element ka field Biot–Savart law deta hai; symmetric cases (lambi wire, solenoid, toroid) mein Ampere's circuital law se jaldi nikalta hai.

Magnetic field chalte charge par force lagata hai: F = q(v × B). Yeh force hamesha velocity ke perpendicular hai, isliye speed nahi badalti, kaam zero — sirf direction mudti hai (circle ya helix). E aur B dono hon to Lorentz force F = q(E + v × B).
Current wali wire par F = I(L × B). Do parallel wires: same direction current — attract, ulta — repel; isi se ampere ki definition aati hai.

Current loop ek magnetic dipole hai (m = NIA); uniform field mein net force zero par torque τ = m × B lagta hai. Yahi moving coil galvanometer ka principle hai, jise shunt (chhota R parallel) se ammeter aur bada R series mein lagaakar voltmeter banate hain.

formulas.name: Biot–Savart law
formulas.formula: dB = (μ₀/4π) I dl × r̂ / r² = (μ₀/4π) I dl sinθ / r²
formulas.when: Kisi bhi shape ki wire ka field (chhote tukdon ko jodkar).
formulas.note: r element se point ki taraf hai; θ dl aur r ke beech — dl ki direction current wali.

formulas.name: Field at centre of circular loop
formulas.formula: B = μ₀NI / 2R;   arc (angle φ radian): B = μ₀Iφ / 4πR
formulas.when: Gol coil ya arc ka centre.
formulas.mistake: Arc mein φ radian mein daalo, degree mein nahi.

formulas.name: Field on axis of circular loop
formulas.formula: B = μ₀NIR² / [2(R² + x²)^{3/2}];   x ≫ R: B ≈ μ₀m / 2πx³
formulas.when: Coil ke axis par kisi point par.
formulas.mistake: x = 0 rakhne par centre wala formula aana chahiye — check kar lo.

formulas.name: Straight wire
formulas.formula: Finite: B = (μ₀I/4πd)(sinφ₁ + sinφ₂);   infinite: B = μ₀I / 2πd;   semi-infinite end ke saamne: μ₀I/4πd
formulas.when: Seedhi wire se d doori par.
formulas.mistake: Angles perpendicular se naapne hain (wire ke saath nahi).

formulas.name: Ampere's circuital law
formulas.when: Symmetry wale cases: lambi wire, solenoid, toroid, thick wire.
formulas.mistake: Loop ke bahar ka current I_enclosed mein mat gino.

formulas.name: Thick (solid) wire, radius R
formulas.formula: Andar (r < R): B = μ₀Ir / 2πR²;   bahar: B = μ₀I / 2πr
formulas.note: Andar field r ke saath BADHTA hai, surface par max.

formulas.name: Solenoid and toroid
formulas.formula: Lamba solenoid andar: B = μ₀nI (n = turns per metre), end par μ₀nI/2;   toroid: B = μ₀NI / 2πr
formulas.mistake: n turns per METRE hai, total turns nahi.

formulas.name: Force on moving charge (Lorentz)
formulas.formula: F = q(v × B);   |F| = qvB sinθ;   E bhi ho: F = q(E + v × B)
formulas.note: Electron (negative) par direction ulti — Fleming/right-hand ke baad flip karo.

formulas.name: Circular path in uniform B
formulas.formula: r = mv/qB = p/qB = √(2mK)/qB;   T = 2πm/qB;   f = qB/2πm
formulas.mistake: Time period speed par depend NAHI karta (cyclotron isi par chalta hai).

formulas.name: Helical path
formulas.formula: v at angle θ to B: radius = mv sinθ / qB;   pitch = 2πm v cosθ / qB
formulas.mistake: Pitch mein cosθ, radius mein sinθ — ulta mat karo.

formulas.name: Velocity selector
formulas.formula: E aur B perpendicular: undeflected tab jab v = E/B
formulas.mistake: Sirf us speed ke liye; mass/charge kuch bhi ho.

formulas.name: Force on current-carrying wire
formulas.formula: F = I(L × B);   |F| = BIL sinθ;   koi bhi closed loop uniform B mein: F_net = 0
formulas.note: Curved wire ka force uske seedhe end-to-end tukde jitna hota hai.

formulas.name: Force between parallel wires
formulas.formula: F/L = μ₀I₁I₂ / 2πd;   same direction attract, opposite repel
formulas.mistake: Electric charges ka ulta: yahan 'like' currents attract karte hain.

formulas.name: Magnetic dipole moment and torque
formulas.formula: m = NIA (direction right-hand se);   τ = m × B, |τ| = NIAB sinθ;   U = −m·B
formulas.mistake: θ loop ke PLANE se nahi, normal (m) se naapo.

formulas.name: Moving coil galvanometer
formulas.formula: NIAB = kφ ⇒ φ = (NAB/k) I;   current sensitivity φ/I = NAB/k;   voltage sensitivity φ/V = NAB/(kR_G)
formulas.mistake: Turns badhane se current sensitivity badhti hai, voltage sensitivity zaroori nahi (R bhi badhta hai).

formulas.name: Galvanometer → ammeter / voltmeter
formulas.formula: Ammeter: shunt S = I_g G / (I − I_g) parallel mein.   Voltmeter: R = V/I_g − G series mein
formulas.mistake: Ammeter ka resistance bahut kam, voltmeter ka bahut zyada — ulta jodne par meter jal sakta hai.

examples.title: Electron par force aur radius
examples.problem: Electron 2 × 10⁶ m/s se B = 0.5 T ke perpendicular chal raha hai. Force aur circle ka radius? (m_e = 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg)

examples.title: Cyclotron frequency
examples.problem: Proton B = 1 T mein ghoom raha hai. Frequency? (m_p = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg)
examples.solution: f = qB/2πm = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ / (2π × 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷) ≈ 1.52 × 10⁷ Hz — speed par depend nahi.

examples.title: Coil ke centre par field
examples.problem: 10 turns, radius 10 cm, current 2 A. Centre par B?

examples.title: Lambi wire
examples.problem: Lambi seedhi wire mein 10 A. 5 cm door B?

examples.title: Solenoid
examples.problem: Solenoid mein 1000 turns per metre, current 2 A. Andar B?

examples.title: Parallel wires ka force
examples.problem: Do lambi parallel wires 10 cm door, currents 5 A aur 10 A same direction. Force per metre?

examples.title: Coil par torque
examples.problem: 50 turns, area 0.02 m², current 1 A, B = 0.2 T; coil ka normal B se 30° par. Magnetic moment aur torque?

examples.title: Galvanometer ko ammeter aur voltmeter
examples.problem: G = 50 Ω, full-scale I_g = 5 mA. (a) 0–5 A ammeter (b) 0–10 V voltmeter?
examples.solution: (a) S = I_g G/(I − I_g) = 0.005 × 50/4.995 ≈ 0.05 Ω parallel mein. (b) R = V/I_g − G = 2000 − 50 = 1950 Ω series mein.

examples.title: Velocity selector
examples.problem: E = 10⁴ V/m aur B = 0.02 T crossed hain. Kis speed ke charges seedhe nikal jaayenge?

examples.title: Wire par force
examples.problem: 0.5 m wire mein 3 A, B = 0.4 T ke perpendicular. Force?

examples.title: Helix ki pitch
examples.problem: Electron 2 × 10⁶ m/s se B = 0.01 T ke saath 60° angle par ghusta hai. Pitch?

examples.title: Axis par field
examples.problem: 1 turn, R = 10 cm, I = 1 A. Axis par centre se 10 cm door B?

topics.title: Oersted ka experiment
topics.explain: Current wali wire ke paas compass ki needle mud jaati hai — matlab current magnetic field banata hai. Current ulta karo to needle ulti mudti hai. Field lines wire ke chaaron taraf gol (concentric) hoti hain.

topics.title: Direction ke rules
topics.explain: Right-hand thumb rule: angootha current ki direction, ungliyan B ki direction (lambi wire). Loop/solenoid mein ungliyan current ke saath mudao, angootha B (north) dikhata hai. Force ke liye F = q(v × B) ka cross product ya Fleming's left-hand rule.

topics.title: Biot–Savart ke applications
topics.explain: Circular loop ke centre aur axis par field, arc ka field, finite wire. Field current ke proportional aur doori ke square ke ulta (element ke liye).

topics.title: Ampere's law ke applications
topics.explain: Infinite wire (B ∝ 1/r), solid wire ke andar (B ∝ r), solenoid (andar uniform μ₀nI, bahar ≈ 0), toroid (andar μ₀NI/2πr, bahar zero). Amperian loop aisa chuno jahan B constant aur dl ke parallel ho.

topics.title: Charge ki motion E aur B mein
topics.explain: Sirf B: circle (v ⊥ B), helix (tircha), seedha (v ∥ B, force zero). Magnetic force kaam nahi karta ⇒ KE constant. E aur B crossed: velocity selector. Cyclotron: f = qB/2πm se charges ko baar-baar accelerate karta hai.

topics.title: Definition of ampere
topics.explain: Do anant lambi parallel wires 1 m door hon aur har mein itna current ho ki unke beech 2 × 10⁻⁷ N per metre force lage — woh current 1 ampere. (2019 se SI mein ampere elementary charge e se define hota hai, lekin yeh relation sach hai.)

topics.title: Current loop as a magnetic dipole
topics.explain: Loop ek chhote bar magnet jaisa behave karta hai: m = NIA, ek face north ek south. Door se iska field dipole jaisa (1/r³). Uniform field mein net force zero, torque m × B — loop m ko B ke saath align karna chahta hai.

topics.title: Moving coil galvanometer
topics.explain: Coil radial magnetic field mein (concave poles + soft iron core) ⇒ har position par sinθ = 1, deflection current ke proportional (linear scale). Spring ka restoring torque kφ. Sensitivity badhaane ke liye N, B, A badhao ya k ghatao.

ratta: Loop centre μ₀NI/2R;  wire μ₀I/2πd;  solenoid μ₀nI.
m = NIA;  τ = mB sinθ;  U = −mB cosθ.
Shunt S = I_g G/(I − I_g);  series R = V/I_g − G.
Magnetic force kabhi kaam nahi karta.
